prose: Cognition's Devin Review 2.0 becomes the default PR review tool when working with Devin. Since August the cost of reviewing a PR fell 82% to about $0.25-$0.75, cheap enough to run on every PR, through a better model mix and harness tuning. Bugs found per PR rose from 1.22 to 1.32, and each fixed bug costs about $2.25 on average. The argument is that code review is the new bottleneck as PR volume rises, and agents should assist rather than skipping review. It also produces a guided PR tour for faster human review. Vendor-reported.
highlights: Review cost per PR down 82% to $0.25-$0.75
Bugs found per PR up from 1.22 to 1.32
Guided tour of the PR for human reviewers; vendor figures
